numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterBinding.jsonsc.description: AdapterBinding is one provider installation serving a port.

instance.description: instance is required: the configured instance of the provider (one provider may serve several, such as two CI servers).

provider.description: provider is required: the extension id of a provider of the port, which must resolve to a lockfile entry.

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterBinding.jsonsc.title: Adapter Binding

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterPorts.jsonsche.description:
AdapterPorts binds the ports that reach customer systems; a port added later is a new
 optional field. Each binding is replaced as a unit, never pairing one scope's provider with another's instance.

knowledge.description:
knowledge names the KnowledgeConnection objects the scope may read; a narrower scope's list replaces the wider one.
 Deprecated in 1.3.0: a knowledge source is an MCP-backed plugin named in AdapterSelectorSpec.tools (design sections 14 and 17).

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterPorts.jsonsche.title: Adapter Ports
